principle: A witness certifies only the proposition inside its declared claim boundary.

composition.rule: Independent witnesses accumulate evidence; no witness inherits the authority of another.
composition.conflict_policy: A failed mandatory witness dominates passing sibling witnesses for the grade that requires it. Conflicting non-mandatory witnesses remain visible and require adjudication.

witnesses.name: Deterministic unit tests
witnesses.claim: Enumerated local implementation invariants hold for the tested cases.
witnesses.authority: pytest assertions in the pinned repository commit

witnesses.name: Static type witness
witnesses.claim: The checked Python surface satisfies the configured mypy type constraints.

witnesses.name: Browser contract witness
witnesses.claim: The generated web artifact satisfies the explicitly tested browser/runtime contract in Chromium.
witnesses.authority: Playwright browser smoke against generated _site artifact

witnesses.name: Automated WCAG witness
witnesses.claim: axe-core reports zero automatically detectable WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 Level A/AA violations on every primary product page.

witnesses.name: Reproducibility witness
witnesses.claim: Repeated builds from identical declared inputs produce byte-identical site output.

witnesses.name: Static site resource budget witness
witnesses.claim: The generated static site remains within the versioned first-party and single-vendor byte budgets.
witnesses.authority: deterministic byte counts over the generated _site artifact

witnesses.name: Formal proof replay witness
witnesses.claim: The pinned Four Color formal artifact is accepted by the pinned Rocq checker/toolchain.
witnesses.authority: Rocq kernel/checker on pinned upstream artifact

witnesses.name: Lean distinction-preservation micro-witness
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the stated Brown Goo distinction-preservation and contextual factorization theorems in examples/brown_goo/BrownGoo.lean.
non_claims: that every lossy abstraction is operationally harmful

witnesses.name: Lean Four Color frame-separated V4 micro-core
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the stated Klein-four palette laws and cyclic closure/parity; the fixed-region gauge theorem with 3,1,1 tangential V4 modes; the Track-B hard-frontier 2,1,1,1 absolute-color theorem; and the theorem that these two frontier frames are not silently identical.
non_claims: a transport from the fixed-region gauge frame to the Track-B hard frontier
a new proof of the Four Color Theorem
semantic equivalence with the Python research implementation

witnesses.name: Lean hard frontier A-B-A shape witness
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the stated theorem that every proper degree-five frontier using all four colors contains a cyclic A-B-A window: its unique repeated absolute color occurs at distance two on the 5-cycle.
non_claims: alternating-endpoint crossing in a planar disk
the Jordan or crosscut theorem used by the human C2 argument
a new proof of the Four Color Theorem
witnesses.authority: pinned Lean kernel/toolchain over hard-frontier shape theorems in examples/four_color/FourColorCore.lean

witnesses.name: Lean C2 contact/void reduction witness
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the stated contact/void C2 reduction: void is distinct from the four palette states; the coarse Brown projection cannot separate those four operational color states; the canonical A-B-A-C-D boundary is attached to concrete carrier terminals; the {A,D} and {B,C} carrier families are vertex-disjoint by their operational color types; and an explicit planar crosscut-intersection premise entails at least one clean boundary carrier.
non_claims: the Jordan or crosscut intersection theorem represented by crosscut_meets_opposite
construction of a CleanAtomicTurn from the clean carrier incidence alone
normalization from every cyclic HasABAWindow witness to the canonical A-B-A-C-D naming
a new proof of the Four Color Theorem
that Brown can adjudicate the game's color-contact obligations

witnesses.name: Lean C2 forced third-state witness
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the V4 forcing law that fixing one lower/reference palette state leaves exactly three nontrivial upward states; any two distinct upward states uniquely determine the third as reference + left + right; that forced state lies outside the interacting bichromatic pair; and in the canonical gauge A=0, B=a, C=b the forced remaining state is D=c.
non_claims: that planar geometry forces the relevant interaction or crossing
the Jordan or crosscut intersection theorem represented by crosscut_meets_opposite
a new proof of the Four Color Theorem

witnesses.name: Lean Brown affordance factorization witness
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the stated observer-relative playability result: Brown distinguishes void from colored occupancy, but distinct formal color contacts can have the same Brown observation and different legal local move profiles; therefore the exact color-contact affordance profile does not factor through Brown's projection, while it does factor through direct color observation.
non_claims: that every coarse observer is unable to play every game
the Jordan or crosscut intersection theorem represented by crosscut_meets_opposite
a new proof of the Four Color Theorem

witnesses.name: Lean atomic Four Color turn witness
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the stated theorem that one atomic closed bichromatic carrier swap preserves proper coloring.
non_claims: a new proof of the Four Color Theorem
semantic equivalence with the Python Kempe implementation
witnesses.authority: pinned Lean kernel/toolchain over atomic-turn theorems in examples/four_color/FourColorCore.lean

witnesses.name: Lean clean frontier effect witness
witnesses.claim: The Lean kernel accepts the stated clean-turn effect theorems: a supplied clean atomic turn changes only its unique frontier seed, and a singleton-colored clean seed frees its old color from the realized successor frontier.
non_claims: the planar alternating-endpoint or Jordan-crosscut lemma needed for C2
a new proof of the Four Color Theorem
witnesses.authority: pinned Lean kernel/toolchain over clean-frontier effect theorems in examples/four_color/FourColorCore.lean

witnesses.name: Differential execution witness
witnesses.claim: For the frozen finite graph corpus in certification/differential-four-color-v1.json, the checked-in Python source and executable MeTTa agree on 4-colorability and every returned coloring is independently validated.
witnesses.authority: independent Python-process and pinned MeTTaScript execution plus graph-level witness validation

witnesses.name: Metamorphic semantic witness
witnesses.claim: Semantics-preserving source perturbations preserve recovered labels while evidence relocates appropriately.

witnesses.name: Mutation sensitivity witness
witnesses.claim: The test suite detects a defined proportion of meaningfully mutated implementations.
witnesses.authority: pinned mutation operator set and mutation score

witnesses.name: Fuzz and parser resilience witness
witnesses.claim: Adapters and parsers satisfy declared crash/resource/error-handling properties over the fuzz campaign.
witnesses.authority: seeded fuzz corpus and campaign artifacts

witnesses.name: Supply-chain provenance witness
witnesses.claim: Release artifacts carry declared dependency inventory, licenses, hashes, and build provenance.

witnesses.name: Performance and resource witness
witnesses.claim: Certified workloads remain within declared time, memory, output-size, and browser-asset budgets.
